A1_universe_drift_protection.description: Added protected_symbols parameter to DynamicUniverseSelector. SH and PSQ are now protected from rotation by default (env: ORGANISM_PROTECTED_SYMBOLS). Protected symbols are persisted in brain and restored on restart.

A2_scanner_decoupled_from_entry_blocking.description: Removed 'not entries_blocked' from market scanner gate condition. Scanner now runs regardless of entry block state, keeping tension_lookup populated. Breaks the equity-zero → scanner-off → tension-zero → confidence-zero death spiral.

A3_runtime_snapshot_hardening.description: Runtime snapshot now reports unreachable_reason when API is down and includes scanner_candidates_count in live section.

A4_pending_entry_restart_hardening.description: Pending entry dict is now persisted to brain extra_counters and restored on initialize(). Restored entries receive fresh tick timestamps for proper cooldown. Prevents duplicate order submissions after restart.
